title: De Zerbi Build-Up
subtitle: Baiting the press to create space

acts.title: 1. The Setup
acts.caption: Brighton sets up in their deep 4-2-4 build up structure against a high press.

acts.title: 2. Studs on the Ball
acts.caption: GK puts his foot on the ball to invite the press.

acts.title: 3. Pass to CB
acts.caption: GK passes to RCB. The opponent's 10 continues his pressing run.

acts.title: 4. Baiting the Winger
acts.caption: RCB holds the ball, waiting for the opponent's RM to jump.

acts.title: 5. Short Pass to Pivot
acts.caption: RCB passes to the 8 dropping slightly. This triggers the opponent's CM.

acts.title: 6. First-Time Layoff
acts.caption: The 8 plays a first-time bounce pass to the LCB as the third man.

acts.title: 7. Shifting the Press
acts.caption: The press has shifted right. LCB now has time, and the opponent's 9 jumps to press.

acts.title: 8. Opening the Passing Lane
acts.caption: The opponent's CM1 steps up slightly to cover the 6, opening a lane to the 10.

acts.title: 9. Breaking the Lines
acts.caption: LCB drills a vertical pass straight into the dropping 10.

acts.title: 10. The Wall Pass
acts.caption: The 10 lays it off immediately to the 6, who has run into the vacated midfield space.

acts.title: 11. Facing Forward
acts.caption: The 6 receives facing the opponent's goal. The press is broken.

acts.title: 12. Attacking Space
acts.caption: The 6 drives forward. Wingers activate and make diagonal runs.

acts.title: 13. The Through Ball
acts.caption: 6 slides a through ball between the LB and LCB for the LW.

acts.title: 14. Creating the Chance
acts.caption: LW receives the ball in stride inside the box.
